lines.rookie: Look for three marks.
lines.junior: Look for three signs.
lines.master: Search for three telling signs.

lines.rookie: Where are the ten logs? Tap the place.
lines.junior: Where are the ten logs now? Tap the place.
lines.master: Where are the ten changed logs now? Tap the place.

lines.rookie: Nothing here. Look at the ground.
lines.junior: Nothing here. Look at the ground.
lines.master: Nothing here. Look carefully at the ground.

lines.rookie: Where could the logs be? Tap.
lines.junior: Where could the logs be? Tap a place.
lines.master: Where could the logs be hidden? Tap a place.

lines.junior: Two men carrying a log
lines.master: Two men hauling a log

lines.rookie: Workers cut stones.

lines.rookie: It burned in 1592.
lines.junior: It burned down in 1592.
lines.master: The palace burned down in a war in 1592. It lay in ruins for hundreds of years.

lines.rookie: The work began in 1865. Every house paid.
lines.junior: The work began in 1865. Every house had to pay.
lines.master: The work began in 1865. Every house had to give money, and few could say no.

lines.rookie: With the new coin, rice costs more.
lines.junior: With the new coin, rice costs more.
lines.master: Since the new coin came, rice costs more.

lines.rookie: Where would ten palace logs go?
lines.junior: Where would ten palace logs go?
lines.master: So where could ten palace logs go?

lines.rookie: Who cut the lines? Who wrote the note?
lines.junior: Who cut the new lines? Who wrote the note?
lines.master: Who cut the new lines? And who wrote the note?

lines.rookie: Use one card for each question.
lines.junior: Use one card for each question.
lines.master: Use one card for each of his questions.

lines.rookie: The chisel: cart card. The pine tree: yard book.
lines.junior: The chisel: on the cart card. The pine tree: in the yard book.
lines.master: The chisel: on the cart card. The pine tree: in the yard book.

lines.rookie: Who changed the logs? Who wrote the note?
lines.junior: Who changed the logs? And who wrote the note?
lines.master: Who changed the logs? And who wrote the warning note?

lines.rookie: What does the palace cost the people?
lines.junior: What does the palace cost the people?
lines.master: What does the new palace cost the people?

lines.rookie: Every house pays. Farmers come to work.
lines.junior: Every house pays. Farmers come to work here.
lines.master: Every house pays. Farmers must come to work.

lines.rookie: Prices are high. But the palace must stand.
lines.junior: Prices are high. But the palace must stand.
lines.master: Since the new coin, prices are high. It is hard for people, but the palace must stand.

lines.rookie: That does not show a new line.

lines.rookie: Which card shows a new line?

lines.master: Which card says one mark has a new line?

lines.rookie: He asks: "Who cut the new lines?"
lines.junior: He asks: "Mr. Pyo only bought them. Who cut the new lines?"
lines.master: The Daewongun asks: "Mr. Pyo says he only bought them. So who cut the new lines?"

lines.rookie: His chisel has fresh wood dust.
lines.junior: His chisel has fresh wood dust on it.
lines.master: The chisel in his cart has fresh wood dust.

lines.rookie: So he cut the new lines.
lines.junior: So he cut the new lines himself.
lines.master: So he cut the new lines himself.

lines.rookie: That does not show who cut them.
